root_cause.text: RCU read-side critical section is ended (rcu_read_unlock) before dereferencing the RCU-protected opinfo pointer, creating a window where a concurrent writer can free the memory, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves rcu_read_unlock() from before the opinfo checks to after them; the commit message explicitly states "opinfo pointer obtained via rcu_dereference(fp->f_opinfo) is being accessed after rcu_read_unlock() has been called."

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch moves rcu_read_unlock() from before the opinfo checks to after them; the commit message explicitly states "opinfo pointer obtained via rcu_dereference(fp->f_opinfo) is being accessed after rcu_read_unlock() has been called."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix RCU read lock misuse by extending the critical section to cover access to RCU-protected fields, preventing a use-after-free race.
intent_record.what: Moved the rcu_read_unlock() call from after rcu_dereference() to after the condition check that accesses opinfo and its fields, with a separate unlock inside the if block for early return.
intent_record.how: Previously, the RCU read lock was released before accessing opinfo->is_lease and opinfo->o_lease->version, allowing a concurrent RCU grace period to free the pointed-to object. Now the lock is held during these accesses, preventing a use-after-free race.
